scope: Sweep allocation failures through whole-operation AC1032 DXF writes containing a variable-size SECTION_SETTINGS record, then verify rollback, same-codec retry and typed readback.

source.profile: One SECTION_SETTINGS object with one settings type, two remapped source handles, a remapped destination block, a destination filename and two nested geometry-setting entries. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a focused mode to the whole-operation allocation harness. Warm the writer, calibrate allocations with an existing destination, inject one-shot allocation failures at every measured offset, and verify nested caller fields, destination bytes, source-handle binding rollback and staging cleanup. Retry on the same codec and require byte-identical output plus typed readback of references, destination filename and geometry settings.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests -j4: PASS; ASan target build: PASS
validation.directRun: PASS; ASCII 102 and Binary 100 allocation offsets injected; caller/destination/identity rollback, staging cleanup, same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated transaction evidence for one AC1032 SECTION_SETTINGS profile does not establish producer-authored wire semantics or version-wide interoperability.
Other type/geometry combinations, section ownership graph closure and native consumer behavior remain unqualified.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
